name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0 (169 commits), introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub for Slack/Discord/Google over MCP, and a mobile-responsive layout. Prior releases in the v0.4.x line (all 2026-04-30) added a Skills system, multi-provider BYOAI runtime (8 CLI providers including Claude, Codex, Gemini), a terminal mode, and Tasks Board v2. v0.4.0 also introduced the MIT license. A breaking Rooms migration in v0.4.4 restructures the data directory layout, though existing installs migrate automatically with a backup. See releases at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in April–May 2026 with active community contributions
answers.Does it support user authentication?: No explicit user authentication system mentioned; onboarding captures name/email with consent, but no auth layer described

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration (v0.4.4): data/ is now a neutral 'home' container and each room is a top-level cabinet; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and the redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation (v0.4.4).
cabinetai CLI refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or / and recommends ~/Documents/Cabinet (v0.4.4).

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers much more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is heavier to self-host and configure.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides robust document processing and metadata extraction but requires more infrastructure setup compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a feature-rich document management system with workflow and user management, making it more suitable for teams but heavier than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers far broader functionality including collaboration and apps but is significantly heavier and more complex to run than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing across multiple storage backends, but lacks the document-management and tagging features of Cabinet.
